kind.access.help: Get a copy of the personal data {org} holds about you.
kind.correction.help: Ask {org} to fix data about you that is wrong or out of date.
kind.erasure.help: Ask {org} to delete your personal data. Some records must be kept by law and are listed in the reply.
kind.withdrawal.help: Stop {org} from using your data for the purposes you pick. Takes effect as soon as you confirm your email.
kind.grievance.help: Tell {org} about a concern with how your data is handled.
notice.title: How {org} handles your personal data
notice.who.b: {org} decides why and how your personal data is used and is responsible for it under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
notice.collect.b: The details you give {org}, such as your name, email address, phone number and what you asked about, and records of your conversations and visits with {org}.
notice.why.b: To reply to you, provide what you asked for, keep our records, and, only if you agreed, to send you updates. You can withdraw any agreement at any time.
notice.share.b: Staff of {org} who need it for their work, and service providers who host or process data for {org} under contract. Your data is not sold.
notice.where.b: On cloud servers in {region}. Moving personal data outside India is allowed unless the government restricts the country.
notice.keep.b: Only as long as needed for the purposes above or as the law requires, then it is deleted or made anonymous.
notice.rights.b: You can ask {org} to show you your data, correct it, erase it, or stop using it for a purpose you agreed to. You can also nominate someone to exercise these rights for you. {org} replies within {days} days.
notice.grievance.b: Write to {who} at {email}. {org} replies within {hours}. If you are not satisfied you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
notice.grievance.none: Use the form on this page to reach {org}'s privacy contact. If you are not satisfied you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
form.title: Make a privacy request
form.sub: We email a link to confirm it is you before anything is recorded. Your email address is not kept with the request.
form.kind: What do you want to do
form.emailHelp: Use the address {org} has for you.
form.detailsHelp: What should be corrected, or what is your concern. Up to 1000 characters.
form.sentBody: If the address is valid we sent a link. Open it within {hours} hours and press the confirm button to record your request.
form.errKind: Pick what you want to do.
form.errDetails: Add a few words of detail (up to 1000 characters).
form.errRate: Too many requests from here. Try again later.
form.errUnavailable: Requests cannot be sent right now. Please try again later or contact the organisation directly.
unavailable.title: Privacy page not available
unavailable.body: This page needs a live workspace. It is not shown on sample or unconfigured deployments.
mail.subject: Confirm your request to {org}: {kind}
mail.body:
Someone, hopefully you, asked {org} to handle this request: {kind}.

To confirm it was you, open this link and press the confirm button. It works for {hours} hours:
{link}

If it was not you, ignore this email and nothing will happen.
verify.title: Confirm your request
verify.ready: You are confirming this request to {org}: {kind}. Nothing is recorded until you press the button.
verify.invalidBody: The link is not valid. Send a new request from the privacy page.
verify.expiredBody: Links work for {hours} hours. Send a new request from the privacy page.
verify.unavailable: Requests cannot be confirmed right now. Please try again later.
verify.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
verify.withdrawnBody: Your consent is withdrawn. It took effect now.
verify.duplicateBody: You already have an open request of this kind. {org} will reply by {due}.
owner.title: Privacy requests
owner.sub: Requests from people about their personal data. Each has a due date; the register is never deleted from.
owner.demoNotice: Sample requests. Nothing here is saved or sent.
owner.deniedBody: Your role ({role}) cannot fulfil privacy requests.
owner.deniedSupport: Privacy requests are not available in a support session.
owner.loadErrorBody: The requests could not be loaded. Try again.
owner.emptyBody: Requests made on your public privacy page appear here. Share the page link in your emails and website footer.
owner.publicPage: Your privacy notice and request form
owner.publicPageHelp: Share this link in your emails and website footer. It shows your organisation's notice and the form people use to ask for access, correction or erasure.
owner.publicPageNone: This workspace has no public address yet, so there is no link to share. Ask support to set the workspace slug.
owner.platformPolicyHelp: How the platform itself handles personal data. Link it next to your own notice if your customers ask.
owner.link.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
owner.col.subject: Person
detail.completeNote: What was done (kept in the notes)
detail.linkLeadHelp: No record matched the requester's email. If you found them by hand, paste the record id.
detail.closed: This request is closed. Raise a new request if more is needed.
detail.access.title: Access bundle
detail.access.body: Downloads everything this workspace holds about the person as one file. Send it to them through a channel you trust. Each download is logged.
detail.correction.title: Correction
detail.correction.body: Fix the data on the record, then mark the request completed and say what changed.
detail.erasure.title: Erasure
detail.erasure.body: Erases the person through the audited erase function, then clears linked records, vectors and calendar entries. Copies in connected tools are listed for you to erase at the source.
detail.erasure.owner: Only a workspace owner can erase. It is not available in a support session.
detail.erasure.confirmBody: This blanks their name, email, phone and messages and cannot be undone. A record of the erasure is kept in the consent log and audit log.
detail.erasure.needLead: Link a record first, or reject the request if there is nothing to erase.
detail.withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
detail.withdrawal.body: Applied automatically when the person confirmed their email: consent log rows, lead flags and the unsubscribe list. Nothing more to do.
detail.grievance.title: Grievance
detail.grievance.body: Reply to the person yourself, record what you said in the notes, then mark the request completed.
consent.title: Record consent
consent.body: Use this when someone gives or withdraws consent by phone, in person or on paper. It adds a line to the consent log.
consent.needLead: Link a record to capture consent for it.
result.leadNotFound: No such record in this workspace.
result.invalid: Check the values and try again.
result.erasedPartial: Erasure ran but some steps need attention. See the list.
result.notOwner: Only a workspace owner can erase.
result.supportBlocked: Not available in a support session.
retention.title: Retention
retention.sub: How long each kind of data is kept. When the time is up the job marks the row deleted or clears its personal fields. Rows marked deleted are removed later by a separate purge job.
retention.jobOff: Off. Nothing is deleted or cleared until an owner turns the job on.
retention.jobUnknown: Job state could not be read.
retention.emptyBody: Without a rule, data is kept until someone removes it. Add a rule per kind of data.
retention.dryRunHelp: A dry run. It counts rows older than each rule and changes nothing.
breach.title: Breach register
breach.sub: A record of every personal-data breach: what happened, who is affected and who was told. Owners only.
breach.setup: The breach register is not available yet. Contact Synthan support.
breach.emptyBody: Record an incident as soon as you become aware of it, even if details are still unknown.
breach.categoriesHelp: Comma separated, for example names, phone numbers, email addresses.
breach.hint72: The Board report is due 72 hours after you become aware. Confirm the exact duties with your counsel.
